uee.set.fields.only: only these fields: %s (identity fields are always kept)
uee.set.tags.only: only elements tagged %s (untagged elements are excluded)
uee.set.maxFile.none: no byte-based file limit; shards split by record count
uee.set.maxFile.limit: shards split at about %s MiB (a whole record may overshoot)
uee.set.dryRun: dry run: nothing will be written, but the plan is real
uee.set.assets.on: assets: textures, models, sounds and language files will be copied
uee.set.delta.on: delta: only what changed since the last run will be written
uee.set.autoRun.on: auto-run: an export will run when a game starts
uee.set.persist.none: nothing will be kept between runs
uee.set.userDir.default: state directory: back to the default
uee.err.badShards: /uee set shards <records>, where records is at least 1
uee.err.badMaxFile: /uee set max-file-mb <n>, where n is 0 or more
uee.err.languageUnknown: no messages are shipped in '%s'; available: %s
uee.err.settingMustCarryLayer: a setting must carry a layer
uee.cmd.configUnreadable: could not read the config file: %s
uee.export.partialFailures: %s element(s) could not be collected; the run continued and the list is in the output
uee.export.willBeTold: you will be told when it finishes
uee.jobs.alreadyStarted: job #%s has already started; an export in progress is not interrupted because a partly written bundle cannot be told from a complete one
uee.set.inEffect: in effect until the server restarts; /uee config save makes it permanent
uee.status.nothingFound: nothing found by the checks that need no collection
uee.status.more: ... and %s more; /uee export analysis writes them all out
uee.status.headline: %s - %s
uee.kinds.pluralNote: name a category in either its singular or its plural form
uee.formats.note1: json grouped document · ndjson one record per line · wiki importer projection
uee.formats.note2: td / zd tie ecosystem · yaml / toml / xml generic interchange
uee.config.wroteEffective: wrote the effective configuration to %s (%s bytes)
uee.config.wroteTemplate: wrote the annotated default configuration to %s (%s bytes)
uee.config.templateNote: every key is documented in place; edit it and run /uee config reload
uee.config.setHelps9: /uee set quiet | noisy | dry-run | icons | no-icons
uee.config.setHelps10: every one of these is also a config file key; /uee config template lists them
uee.declare.none: nothing declared; /uee declare asset-kind <name> adds one
uee.declare.sweepCovers: the sweep covers %s kind(s) and %s root file(s)
uee.declare.whereIsIt: declarations and settings are kept in %s
uee.declare.moveIt: set 'user_dir' or the %s environment variable to move it
uee.declare.addedKind: declared asset kind %s; the sweep now covers %s kind(s)
uee.declare.removedKind: removed asset kind %s; the sweep now covers %s kind(s)
uee.declare.badKind: %s cannot be swept as a kind; %s
uee.declare.kindWhy: it has to be one path segment of lower-case letters, digits, underscore, dash or dot, and must not begin with a dot
uee.declare.rootFileWhy: it has to be a bare file name of lower-case letters, digits, underscore, dash or dot, with no directory separator, since it is fetched by name and not by prefix
uee.flow.whereConfig: a configuration flow goes at data/<namespace>/uee/flows/<id>.json
uee.target.none: no datapack defines a collection target
uee.strategy.none: no datapack defines an analysis strategy
uee.datapack.none: none; /uee flow and /uee targets will be empty
uee.help.exportKinds: %s export [kinds]       choose which categories to export
uee.help.halves: %s data | analysis       only one half of a run
uee.help.analyze: %s analyze               run the checks that need no export
uee.help.exportAsync: %s export async [kinds]  start an export and return at once
uee.help.job: %s job <id> [cancel]     inspect or cancel a job
uee.help.tokens: %s kinds | formats       list the accepted tokens
uee.help.set: %s set <what> …        override a setting for this session
uee.help.categories: categories: %s, or any name from %s kinds
uee.help.callable: callable from %s; use 'export async' there so the tick is not held
uee.flow.badFunctionId: %s is not a valid function id
uee.config.writeNotVisible: the write to %s did not leave a readable file, so nothing was saved
uee.app.name: Universal Element Exporter
